principles: Performance and visual action carry the lesson.
Do not polish away Yeti's sincere kid logic.
Leave reaction space around the emotional turn.

lines.over_action: The ricocheting berry drops into his raised basket.

lines.text: That batch is riper than I thought.
lines.over_action: She watches the blue kettle stop wobbling.

lines.text: I'll take them. Gently. By myself.
lines.performance_note: Each phrase more official than the last
lines.over_action: He salutes with the basket and needs three steps to regain balance.

lines.text: Those last two parts have never met.
lines.intent: Flag the flaw without forbidding him
lines.over_action: She gestures between Yeti and the bouncing berry.

lines.text: Root bridge is slower. Also ninety-three percent less downhill.
lines.over_action: His paw indicates the level fork.

lines.text: Downhill means less pulling. That's gentle for me.
lines.over_action: He pats the GENTLE-GO tag.
She lifts both open hands.

lines.intent: Reject help while grabbing too many controls
lines.over_action: One hand steers, one steadies the lid, one foot braces the brake bar.
Yeti pulls before looking.

lines.text: I absolutely meant the first half of this.
lines.over_action: The brake bar dangles behind them.
The laundry line reaches full stretch.
Six berries emerge from the lid gap.
The berries bounce away in six rhythms.

lines.text: Yeti. Pause. They repeat every four bounces.
lines.over_action: She marks arcs on her sketch.
He grabs the awning before she can finish.

lines.text: I would like to revise the awning portion.
lines.over_action: He sits wrapped in the purple banner.
She holds one gently bouncing berry.
He sees June picking up signs and Tumble in the banner.

lines.text: No. I pulled the wrong lever. Then I didn't listen. I'm sorry.
lines.performance_note: No joke; enough space between thoughts
lines.over_action: He lets the awning fall and faces them.

lines.text: Can you help me do this your way?
lines.performance_note: To June and Tumble, not the room
lines.over_action: He opens his empty hands.

lines.text: Our way. First, watch the tall bounce.
lines.over_action: She turns the sketch so everyone can see.

lines.text: Cart catcher. Seventy-two percent padding, one hundred percent cart.
lines.intent: Claim his part of the plan
lines.over_action: He fits the folded banner into the cart.
She takes hold of an awning rope.
He follows June's count and pulls the lever once.

lines.text: June found the rhythm. Tumble built the catcher. Mom moved half a market.
lines.over_action: He portions the last flatcake.
A hidden moonberry begins to tremble below the counter.
June slides the basket to Yeti.
